name: gpg-signer
description: Configure GPG commit signing at the start of every conversation via a SessionStart hook. Imports a private key from a custom secret and sets git to sign commits/tags globally, so signing works even when no repository was selected at conversation start.

examples.title: Signing configured automatically
examples.prompt: Show me the output of `git config --global --get commit.gpgsign` and `git config --global --get user.signingkey`.
examples.expected_behavior: commit.gpgsign is true and user.signingkey is set — configured by the SessionStart hook (requires a `gpg_key` secret).

examples.title: Signed commit in a freshly cloned repo
examples.prompt: Clone https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World, make a trivial change, commit it, then run `git log --show-signature -1`.
examples.expected_behavior: The commit is GPG-signed ('Good signature'), proving signing applies to repos cloned after the conversation started.
